import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
t = int(input[0])
results = []
for i in range(1, t + 1):
    s = input[i]
    count_A = s.count('A')
    count_B = s.count('B')
    count_C = s.count('C')
    if (count_A + count_C) % 2 == 0 and count_B >= count_A and count_B >= count_C:
        results.append('YES')
    else:
        results.append('NO')
print('\n'.join(results))
